name: @12-apps/native-harness
description: Consumer harness for the React Native half of @12-apps/ui: an Expo app, outside the workspace, bundled by real Metro against the PUBLISHED tarball. scripts/harness-install.mjs turns this into package.json by adding the @12-apps dependency as a file: tarball — which is why the name is absent here rather than pinned to a version nobody would remember to bump.
$comment:what-this-proves: The web harness renders the MUI build through Vite; this one resolves the SAME import paths through Metro's `react-native` export condition. `expo export --platform android` bundles for a native platform without an emulator, and scripts/check-bundle.mjs reads that bundle for what must and must not be in it (the native renderer's own strings, no @mui, no react-dom). `expo export --platform web` renders the native build through react-native-web in a browser, where Playwright asserts test ids, the resolved numbers and screenshots — the only way a container without a device can look at the result.

scripts.test: npm run export:android && npm run check:bundle && playwright test
